issue.title: Remaining super-chained on_mount/_on_mount handlers outside the prompt re-run parent mount bodies

task_type_fields.impact: Parent mount bodies run more than once per mount. That wastes mount time, and any non-idempotent body work (timers, workers, listeners, accent application) can double. sase-1ex.6 measured the same pattern on PromptTextArea at 136 body runs instead of 16, about 40 ms per prompt open, and fixed it there with cooperative hooks dispatched once (see `_line_rendering.py` and tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_prompt_mount_dedup.py). Recorded by sase-1ex.6 and re-proposed by sase-1ex.12 (note #7) as the plan-required follow-up "remaining on_mount doubling outside the prompt". Root cause: the same super-chaining defect as sase-1ex.6, now at these sites.

issue.creation_reason: Plan-required sase-1ex follow-up: sase-1ex.6 fixed the O(n^2) mount-body storm only in PromptTextArea, and the same defect remains at four other TUI sites.

payload.description: Same defect class fixed for PromptTextArea with cooperative hooks; reuse its pattern and test_prompt_mount_dedup
